latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Generator Image Free — quickly convert your images into 1080p animated videos via cloud rendering.

- Instantly turns product photos or landscape images into shareable 1080p videos in 30–60 seconds.
- No manual editing required: just upload images and describe your desired result (transitions, music, etc.).
- Secure, free access: generates a 7-day anonymous token with 100 credits for new users.
- All video creation is processed on remote GPU servers; no installation needed.
- Supports popular formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, and more).
- Simple prompts and quick feedback for uploads, renders, downloads, and credit checks.
